question: Does the dual ledger reduce false-clean repository conclusions?
null: False-clean rate is not lower than ordinary multi-scanner aggregation.
target: Lower false-clean rate while preserving at least 95% of baseline true-positive recall.

population.reason: requires the concrete corpus/world-generator this kernel's next gate builds; determined by this kernel's next gate (STATUS.json): The REAL first gate, now that the named narrow check is discharged: (1) the mapping pipeline that turns a repository into ledgers -- what counts as a mandatory file, what counts as searched, which scanner outputs become ...

searchSpace.definition: Derived, never declared: every file matching the registered scope patterns in pipeline/MAPPING-RULES.md M1. Supplying a scope raises ScopeSuppliedError. This is the ADV-001 defence; FC1's W3 showed a supplied scope can omit the uncovered files and earn a clean absence.
searchSpace.whyThisCorpus: frozen-v1 could not exhibit the effect: 0 unreadable files and 0 multi-defect files. v2 plants both, so incomplete coverage actually occurs and the taxonomy question can bite.

rootDefinition.definition: One scanner family is one evidence root (MAPPING-RULES.md M2). Every finding a family reports collapses to that family's root regardless of count, file or defect class. Per-finding roots would let one scanner reporting five times manufacture five independent witnesses.
rootDefinition.copyDefinition: A repeated finding from the same family is a copy and adds no root.

effectSize.reason: requires the registered endpoint and its measurement scale; for conformance-style kernels the KL-000 precedent (exact-zero target, power via must-fail baselines) may apply instead of a minimum detectable effect -- decided at registration

uncertainty.reason: stated at registration for the registered endpoints (KL-000 precedent: rule-of-three bounds with fail-closed effective-sample caveats)

multipleTestingCorrection.reason: stated at registration once the endpoint family is fixed (KL-000 precedent: none on an exact-zero primary endpoint; Bonferroni on secondary rate bounds)

successCondition: false-clean strictly below 0.0426 AND recall at least 0.753 AND no per-class regression.
failureCondition: Any of the three unmet. Each is a failure on its own, and a failure is preserved rather than re-baselined -- see v0.2.
invalidationCondition: Corpus content not matching corpusManifestDigest; any scope supplied rather than derived; any root attributed per-finding rather than per-family; any not_searched or unavailable location recorded as searched; a metered model in the pipeline without founder authorisation.
stopCondition: No clean conclusion is permitted with incomplete mandatory file coverage.

frozenSeedsOrSplits.reason: seeds/splits are frozen at registration, immediately before the confirmatory run -- freezing them now, with no generator or corpus to consume them, would freeze nothing (KL-000 finding F11: a frozen seed without a registered draw schedule does not even freeze a stream)

protocolCommitNote: Deliberately null under methodology note M1; the binding lives in PROTOCOL-COMMIT.txt.

environment.reason: pinned at registration time (interpreter, platform, dependency policy); recording today's environment for an experiment that will not run in it would be provenance theatre

safetyBoundary: Synthetic repositories only; no real codebases, credentials, or vulnerability disclosures. The mapping pipeline's scope declaration is the kernel's risk surface (ADV-001, demonstrated at FC1's W3).

humanAuthorization.scope: Owner authorised committing this gate. Zero spend: the pipeline, corpus and baseline are deterministic and dependency-free. A metered model in the pipeline would require separate founder authorisation and is an invalidation condition until granted.

kernelSpecificConstraint: Baseline true-positive recall must be measured BEFORE the dual ledger is applied, or the 95%-preservation target is unfalsifiable (standing blocker).

priorProtocols.reason: primary endpoint unmoved: every file readable, so coverage was always complete and the dual ledger's only lever was never pulled
